sql.sql: SELECT "c"."active" AS "active", "c"."code" AS "code", "c"."concept_id" AS "concept_id", "c"."definition" AS "definition", "c"."display" AS "display" FROM "concept" "c" WHERE (("c"."cs_id" = @cs_id_0) AND "c"."concept_id" IN (SELECT DISTINCT "c"."concept_id" AS "concept_id" FROM "search_fts_display" "f" INNER JOIN "concept" "c" ON ("c"."concept_id" = "f"."rowid") WHERE (("c"."cs_id" = @display_cs_id_2) AND ("c"."active" = 1) AND ("f"."term" MATCH @search_match_1)) UNION SELECT DISTINCT "d"."concept_id" AS "concept_id" FROM "search_fts_designation" "f" INNER JOIN "designation" "d" ON ("d"."designation_id" = "f"."rowid") INNER JOIN "concept" "c" ON ("c"."concept_id" = "d"."concept_id") WHERE (("c"."cs_id" = @designation_cs_id_3) AND ("c"."active" = 1) AND ("d"."active" = 1) AND ("f"."term" MATCH @search_match_1)) UNION SELECT DISTINCT "cl"."source_concept_id" AS "concept_id" FROM "search_fts_literal" "f" INNER JOIN "concept_literal" "cl" ON ("cl"."literal_id" = "f"."rowid") INNER JOIN "concept" "c" ON ("c"."concept_id" = "cl"."source_concept_id") WHERE (("c"."cs_id" = @literal_cs_id_4) AND ("c"."active" = 1) AND ("cl"."active" = 1) AND ("f"."term" MATCH @search_match_1))) AND 1) ORDER BY "c"."code" ASC LIMIT 20
